data_problems_found: Early non-detects with reporting limit 2 mg/L vs late limit 0.2 (21 early cohort rows censored; limits not comparable)
Late results from Synthetic Lab B with no unit reported (cohort wells C00-C07)
Unpaired wells: 30 N-wells sampled only in 2018, no 2005 baseline
Late value identical to early value to 3 digits at 9 wells (possible carried-forward/copied data)
notes: Cohort = 30 wells C00-C29 with both 2005 and 2018 results. No well shows a demonstrable decline: 21 early values are <2 and every late value at those wells is below 2 (cannot compare); 9 wells have identical early/late values. Early median is censored (<2); 1.0 uses DL/2 substitution and is not a measured value. Late cohort median 1.435. Including the 30 2018-only N wells would give an all-well 2018 median of 0.91, which would falsely suggest decline.
